reviews.text: Did a great job and really friendly staff.

First time at this grooming location and what a wonderful experience. Christine was so lovely and patient with me and my little golden doodle Henri . The best grooming experience ever! He came out even cuter then he went in! This place is nowhere near me but I will not go anywhere else now that I found the perfect place and groomer. Thank you Christine!!

UPDATE:
Absolutely  awful grooming experience last week 3/11/26. I have loved bringing Henri here for over 2 years to see the very talented Christine. Even after I moved out of the city, I still brought him in to see her. She was that wonderful. After she left, the owner recomended I bring Henri in to see Michelle.
Last week, after showing her pictures of Henri's past grooms and telling her exactly what I wanted, I came back 2.5 hours later to a unrecognizable dog and a $180 bill! His hair was so short on the nose you could see his skin. His ears were so akwardly cut and uneven. One side of his face was shorter than the other.
I was in shock and could barely say  a word. I just wanted to leave. Even now a week later, I am so disappointed that I ever came back after Cristine left because this woman does NOT know what she's doing.

I saw a recommendation for Unleashed on Reddit and decided to take a chance and go here. My cat Sandy hasn’t been groomed in years, so I was unsure how she would do. The staff were incredibly kind and you can tell they really love the animals. Their pricing was very transparent as well for any additional add-on options. I would 100% recommend Unleashed to any pet owner, especially Han! Sandy has been so zen and relaxed since I brought her home from the groomers today and I know they treated her well 😊

Absolutely amazing experience! They treated my dog with so much care and patience, and the results were perfect. My pup came back clean, fresh, and happy—which says everything. The staff is professional, kind, and truly loves what they do. Highly recommend to any dog parent!

We have the best experiences with Unleashed Spa. They are always so attentive, professional, and our cat Frank LOVES going to the spa. He always comes back and shows off. We were looking for a place that we knew takes great care of our pets, and we found it!

Don’t let the eyes fool you. My cat can be a spicy little guy when it comes to nail clippings, so I’ve come to Unleashed three times now to ask for help after he’s turned me to ribbons.

Han is a miracle worker who’s gotten the job done even though I’ve failed to give the little furball gabapentin and each time. He takes maybe one or two minutes, tops, and even though my cat complains, both groomer and cat make it out unscathed. They’ve got me in as walk-ins every time too. Super impressed!!!

(Edit for typo)
Kim and her team are amazing!  Small shop produces great work.  Our dogs feel safe and happy going to unleashed spa
They always cut down codi's paws. They do an awesome job 👍🏼
Unleashed is the best! I’ve been going to them for 3 years for my toy poodle, and they always do an excellent job. Highly recommend Magno for all your poodle needs.

Nora and I LOVE this place! Unleashed always does a wonderful job on Mr. Cooperton and we can't be happier. It is always fun to give him a spa day and when he comes back he looks fly. Cooper definitely knows he has schwag because he's always a bit friendlier to other people and dogs, usually wanting to meet with every.single.one. he sees. That would be the only con - your dog will know they've been looks maxxed and will act like it!

The team is open to feedback on the cut (i.e., summer cut, winter cut, leave the ears alone, etc) and they always come through. We've used a different stylist every time and they have all been consistently great. Lastly, it's pretty obvious the owner and staff love dogs and that our good boy is taken care of and treated with all the love dogs deserve. I could not recommend more.
Hidden gem! Never had a bad experience. Staff are awesome. 10/10 recommend
Been taking my dog to Unleashed for years. Totally trust her with Han...who always does a wonderful grooming job!!

Santiago did an amazing job with Agnis she looks fabulous and she’s very happy.

Amazing experience. Definitely recommend and going back.

The entire team at Unleashed is fantastic. It isn't easy finding a reliable groomer for cats, but Han is a master. He really has a way with cats that calms them down and his skills are top notch. Convenient appointments and location, highly recommend to anyone looking for a pet groomer!

Hank did an incredible job grooming my miniature schnauzer puppy she finally looks like a true schnauzer again with her clean lines, fluffy legs, and perfectly shaped brows and beard. You can tell he truly understands the breed and takes his time to get every detail right. Hank is hands down the best schnauzer groomer in NYC and I’m so glad we found him!
Only amazing things to say about Unleashed. Edrick at the front desk is so accommodating and my groomer Magno was exceptional.
Magno did a great job - super nice and helpful.
Magno did a FANTASTIC job on our standard poodle!
Highly recommend Christine, she always does a great job and is gentle so I trust her 100%

Breezey got groomed on 7.13.25 and had a reaction to the shampoo, the groomer gave Breezey a rinse on 7.14.24, Breezey was still itchy; Kim (owner) called me first thing in the am on 7.15.25 with deep concern and care in her voice, she she told me to bring him in for a hypoallergenic shampoo. Breezey and I met Kim and her beautiful poodle baby (she should be modeling or doing commericals); we talked in details about the possible cause/reaction to the initial shampoo, Breezey's skin type and solutions to rectify.

Kim isn't just the owner she is Unleashed Spa to the core of her bones, her heart and soul are the Fur Babies; she strives for them and their parents/caretakers to be happy. Kim and I spoke in depth about Fur Babies and the fact that I'm babysitting Breezey, I'm in awe of how she left no stones unturned to see Breezey itch free and happy; she left her door open for updates and/or solutions (you rarely get this type of treatment from Medical Professionals). Where can you see a professional back to back to back get help, information, solutions and treatment???...Unleashed Spa/Kim

A rarity is a company standing behind its name/product/purpose, to go above and beyond...Unleashed Spa is a diamond in the rough.

Thank you Kim for caring, understanding, helping and Vinnie thank you for the shampoo and trim-up.

I will keep you updated.

Magno is amazing! He takes great care of my puppy and always has him looking fluffy and perfect. He really cares and doesn’t take the easy route even when my pup is full of knots. Recommend him and this groomer.
Updating my original rating as the owner reached out to follow up.  Appreciate that effort and the opportunity to make it right.  Thanks Kim.

I was happy with this business for at least a year. The first time was great. Second time with a great groomer (who has since left this place) was even better.  They were two different groomers, fyi. Third time was a disaster. I got pushed into a situation that resulted in my dog just being shaved down for $175. The groomer insisted that my dog was “too matted.” I spoke to the owner about my concerns, including the fact that groomer #2 had no problem just using conditioner and a brush. She apologized and said I should use groomer #2 again. The third time was just fantastic. No extra charge for anything, and the dog was in exactly the same shape he was when groomer #3 shaved him down. Today, I was referred to another groomer, and she tried to pull the same crap as groomer #3. Only this time I was told absolutely no way would groomer #4 do the job without charging me a lot more money for “dematting.”  I said I don’t understand why this is a problem. When I asked what the upcharge would be the owner and the groomer refused to tell me. They said we have no idea how long it will take.”  I said well given your experience how much am I looking at?   Owner: “you just have to trust us.” Really, go in to get a service having no idea what the service will cost? Never.
We brought our very hairy straight haired doodle in for his first cut ever and they did an amazing job! Monty loves his fresh cut and he’s ready for summer
Great job grooming Sabathian
I have been a client for 3 years now and love the service. My Scottish terrier looks incredible every time she is groomed. And the compliments from folks on the street keep pouring. Thank you!!

My dog, Teddy, and I love the groomers over at Unleashed Spa. Even when I moved to the Upper East Side I still trek my way down to Unleashed because they do such a good job. I’ve tried to find a groomer closer to home and haven’t found a place that does as good a job or that I trust as much as Unleashed. I’ve been going to them for almost 8 years at this point. I’d recommend this groomer to any dog owner.
Love them!

These guys really outdo themselves. I’ve brought my dog here 5-6 times and each time I’m like “no THIS is your best haircut!” The staff is so nice, always quick to pick up the phone and get you scheduled. They are so caring with pets and treat each pet like their own. Marianne did my dog’s most recent cut (pictured) and he got so many compliments on our walk back home!

It’s a bit of a pricey groom, $120, but I go every 3-4 months so it balances out in the end. Be aware that there’s an extra $10 fee if your dog has knots in their fur! Overall I highly recommend this spa it’s the best.

Made an appointment for dematting, my dog had 2 matts that developed three days ago she’s a bernedoodle and matts super quickly. The groomer couldn’t decide whether he was going to groomer her or not for 20 minutes and said that he could groom her but might decide to shave her to the skin while grooming. Then proceeded to say if you can’t easily brush through it it’s impossible to do. She has curly hair you can’t easily brush through her hair in general. They then said that they were going to call owner to check to see if they had another groomer and when I spoke to her she said they only dematt for 40 minutes and anything beyond that they’ll shave. This could have been shared over the phone when I made the appointment specifically for dematting. Completely wasted my time and also crazy to say that if they don’t want to put time in to gently detangling hair that they would shave her completely. Owner was also rude while on the phone. Go elsewhere with your doodles!
Good people
Kim, Santi and Marco have always treated me and my dog like royalty. And they were super accommodating with tight corporate schedule. God Bless them.

I’ve been coming here for the past 4 years and it’s the only place I trust to take good care of my Yorkie as they groom her. They do a fabulous job and are always so kind to me and towards my pup, and I’ve never had any issues. Great people and prices, I’m so thankful they’re in the neighborhood!

This spot is a go to for my friends & family. Edrick always exceeds our expectations! He's very professional and will answer any questions or concerns that we have. He goes above and beyond to make sure our dogs are well taken care of. If you're looking for trusted groomers and the best customer service, this is the place to go to :)

While  somewhat nervously waiting for my dearest Billie to be made beautiful once again I watched in amazement as dogs happily entered the grooming parlor giving me a pause  as this is highly unexpected and yet this is what I observed : one happy dog wagging its tail greeted friendly with staff to the next. The
Entire team  is wonderful and always always so fun to chat with…. Whatever magical dog fantasy land that is beyond the white curtain into the grooming station I will never know, but it must be magical.

Adding Liza Minnelli here after Porschia made her even more stunning 💕💕💕

I took Stormy, my long haired cat, here for a grooming plus de-shedding treatment.  The grooming included standard shower, blow dry, brush, nail trim, paw pad trim, ear cleaning, teeth brushing, and sanitary trim!  Most places I looked at have extra charges for some of those services but Unleashed has a fair deal for all of it. They were communicative during the consultation and called me 20 mins before they were done so that I could arrive in time to pick up Stormy without her having to wait long.  I was very satisfied with the service plus Stormy smelled great and looked great after.  I will return for all future grooming needs!

I’ve been taking my dog Kenzo to Unleashed Spa for almost two years, and I can’t recommend them enough! The staff is so friendly and clearly loves what they do. He always comes home looking adorable, feeling happy, and smelling amazing. It’s such a relief knowing he’s in great hands with people who genuinely care. If you’re looking for a grooming spot where your pup will be treated like family, this is it!
Chewbacca has been visiting Unleashed for the past six years since moving to NYC. His groomer, Han, always does an amazing job, leaving Chewie looking his best and happy every time.

I have been coming to Unleashed Spa for 6 years and it has been the best experience. Shannon has been grooming my dog Prince for 6 years every 6 to 7 weeks. She does a phenomenal job and handles him with Love and care. He adores and trusts her. We love unleashed  spa 😍 …

Unleashed is our favorite! They always take great care of Daisy.  She always comes back looking as cute as a button. The staff is friendly and attentive. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a caring and professional groomer in the area!

We love Unleashed and all of their groomers! We’ve been bringing our dog here for at least 4 years and he always comes home happy and handsome! Unleashed takes such great care of him and I cannot recommend them enough for anyone looking for expert grooming with love and attention.
Had many appointments for my dog lola. And this place does an exceptional job and seeing and listening to what needs a person and their dog may need.

We have been bringing our dogs for a long time to Unleashed. Always great and super friendly service and our dogs love their spa visit. Samantha takes care of our little poodle mix, and handles all our requests (special shampoo), and our little pup looks amazing every time. Highly recommended!
Han has been grooming our pup Gloria for 5 years and he is wonderful. Han is so kind and gentle and does a beautiful cut every time.
Unleashed has become our go-to spot for our pup's cuts. Prices are affordable and they always have availability.

We’ve taken our 11yr old mini schnauzer here to be groomed by Han every 8-10weeks since he was 5mos old. We love Han & Unleashed. Our pup always looks like a show dog, people stop us on the street to ask about his haircut. I highly recommend Unleashed.
Unleashed is always very patient with my Havanese.  I would recommend them.
Han and Edrick are great. My dog looks so cute, fluffy and he smells amazing.

I am so grateful for my fabulous spa treatment at "Unleashed Spa".  Of course, my brother and sister - Flame and Tessa - are also thrilled to be flea-free.  We can't wait to be invited to hang with our friends again.  Perhaps dad will even …
Thank you for the stars!  See you soon!
Thank you for the stars! See you soon!
